wpml-ls-current-language wpml-ls-menu-item wpml-ls-first-item menu-item-type-wpml_ls_menu_item menu-item-object-wpml_ls_menu_item menu-item-wpml-ls-116-en"><a class="menu-item wpml-ls-slot-116 wpml-ls-item wpml-ls-item-it wpml-ls-menu-item menu-item-type-wpml_ls_menu_item menu-item-object-wpml_ls_menu_item menu-item-wpml-ls-116-it"><a <div class="content">
<article id="post-2641" class="post_item_single post_type_page post-2641 page type-page status-publish hentry">
<div class="post_content entry-content">
<div class="wpb-content-wrapper"><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12 sc_layouts_column_icons_position_left"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div id="sc_title_1326384433"
class="sc_title sc_title_default"><h2 class="sc_item_title sc_title_title sc_align_center sc_item_title_style_default">FAQ Rooms & Stay</h2></div><div class="vc_empty_space  height_huge"   style="height: 16px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div></div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-8 sc_layouts_column_icons_position_left"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div  class="vc_toggle vc_toggle_round vc_toggle_color_green vc_toggle_color_inverted vc_toggle_size_lg vc_toggle_active"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>What does the price of dorms include?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>The price includes a set of sheets ( and blankets if necessary) that will be changed every 7 days and daily cleaning of bathrooms and dorms.</p>
<p>Also free use of the equipped communal kitchen, living room with TV, game area, outdoor showers, verandas and garden</p>
</div></div><div  class="vc_toggle vc_toggle_round vc_toggle_color_green vc_toggle_color_inverted vc_toggle_size_lg vc_toggle_active"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Are towels included in the price of the dorms?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>No, A set of 3 towels is available at an additional cost of €5.</p>
</div></div><div  class="vc_toggle vc_toggle_round vc_toggle_color_green vc_toggle_color_inverted vc_toggle_size_lg vc_toggle_active"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>What does the price of private room include?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>The price includes the sheets ( and blankets if necessary), a set of towels for each person that will be changed every 7 days and daily cleaning of the bathroom.</p>
<p>Also free use of the equipped communal kitchen, living room with TV, game room, outdoor showers, verandas and garden</p>
</div></div><div  class="vc_toggle vc_toggle_round vc_toggle_color_green vc_toggle_color_inverted vc_toggle_size_lg vc_toggle_active"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Are the dorms equipped with lockable lockers?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Yes, each bed has a locker available and the lock will be given to you at Check-in.</p>
</div></div><div  class="vc_toggle vc_toggle_round vc_toggle_color_green vc_toggle_color_inverted vc_toggle_size_lg vc_toggle_active"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Is breakfast included?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>No, it&#8217;s not. We have a large and well equipped common kitchen for everybody to prepare or you can find few cafes serving breakfast in San Leonardo village.</p>
</div></div><div  class="vc_toggle vc_toggle_round vc_toggle_color_green vc_toggle_color_inverted vc_toggle_size_lg vc_toggle_active"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Do the rooms have air conditioning?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Yes, both dorms and private rooms have air conditioning/heating available</p>
</div></div><div  class="vc_toggle vc_toggle_round vc_toggle_color_green vc_toggle_color_inverted vc_toggle_size_lg vc_toggle_active"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Do private rooms have private bathrooms?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Yes, private rooms have a bathroom for the exclusive use  which, however, is outside the room.</p>
</div></div><div  class="vc_toggle vc_toggle_round vc_toggle_color_green vc_toggle_color_inverted vc_toggle_size_lg vc_toggle_active"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>It is possible to have two single beds in the private room?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>No, it is not possible; the room is equipped with one double bed.</p>
</div></div><div  class="vc_toggle vc_toggle_round vc_toggle_color_green vc_toggle_color_inverted vc_toggle_size_lg vc_toggle_active"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Is it possible to put a baby bed in the private room?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Yes, it is possible, but only in the PIXEL room.</p>
<p>We have a high edged crib 77 cm long or a regular foldable crib available for kids.</p>
</div></div><div  class="vc_toggle vc_toggle_round vc_toggle_color_green vc_toggle_color_inverted vc_toggle_size_lg vc_toggle_active"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Is it possible to do remote work and where?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Yes, it is possible, we have had many guests who have done this in previous seasons.</p>
<p>You can use the veranda which is equipped with tables &amp; chairs and is generally quiet during the day, especially if it&#8217;s windy as most guests will be at the kitesurfing spot. Also the living room if you need quiet during calls.</p>
<p>In addition, the girls dorm has a private garden with tables and chairs.</p>
</div></div><div  class="vc_toggle vc_toggle_round vc_toggle_color_green vc_toggle_color_inverted vc_toggle_size_lg vc_toggle_active"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>What does the kitchen provide?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Our fully equipped kitchen provides A wide range of everyday appliances as well as purified drinking water, local and quality olive oil from our neighbor, coffee, salt/sugar, and spices.</p>
</div></div><div  class="vc_toggle vc_toggle_round vc_toggle_color_green vc_toggle_color_inverted vc_toggle_size_lg vc_toggle_active"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Does the hostel have parking facilities?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>Yes, we have a parking lot in the garden outside the entrance gate.</p>
</div></div><div  class="vc_toggle vc_toggle_round vc_toggle_color_green vc_toggle_color_inverted vc_toggle_size_lg vc_toggle_active"><div class="vc_toggle_title"><h4>Is it possible to bring pets?</h4><i class="vc_toggle_icon"></i></div><div class="vc_toggle_content"><p>We allow pets in our Hostel but not inside the house. It can stay in the garden ( we have a big garden surrounded by a fence)  and only of it gets along peacefully with other pets ( we have one dog and 3 cats).</p>
</div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4 sc_layouts_column_icons_position_left"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"></div></div></div></div>
</div>	</div>
</article>
</div>
